# Braids adapter — windsurf

| | |
|---|---|
| Status | `experimental` |
| Adapter version | 0.1.0-dev.2 |

| Surfaces | desktop |

This adapter contains no Braids methodology. It packages the canonical
`skills/braids` kernel unchanged; `python3 scripts/build_adapters.py --dist dist`
writes the installable tree.

## Generated manifests



## Install

1. python3 scripts/build_adapters.py --dist dist --only windsurf
2. project scope: cp -r dist/windsurf/.windsurf/skills/braids <project>/.windsurf/skills/braids
3. global scope: cp -r dist/windsurf/.windsurf/skills/braids ~/.codeium/windsurf/skills/braids

## Disable

1. remove or rename the installed braids skill directory and reload Cascade

## Uninstall

1. rm -rf <project>/.windsurf/skills/braids ~/.codeium/windsurf/skills/braids dist/windsurf
2. reload Cascade and confirm braids is no longer offered

| authority | pass | adapter ships no rules, hooks, agents, commands, variables or MCP, so it cannot widen the host permission model |
| degradation | pass | no MCP, LSP or hook dependency is declared, so absent optional tools remove no adapter behaviour |
| enforcement-truthfulness | not-applicable | this adapter claims no deterministic blocking |
| state-survival | not-exercised | compaction and resume behaviour was not measured |
| isolation | not-applicable | no subagents or worktrees are shipped |
| uninstall | not-exercised | the host is not installed in this environment, so packaging is validated statically only |

`not-exercised` means exactly that: the behaviour was not directly tested here
and is not claimed.

## Limitations

- Windsurf documentation now redirects to docs.devin.ai; the product surface is moving and must be revalidated before any release claim.
- No plugin manifest format is documented, so the adapter ships a skill directory only.
- Enterprise system-level skill directories are read-only and are not written by this adapter.
- Cascade also reads .agents/skills and, when Claude Code config reading is enabled, .claude/skills, so a Braids copy installed for another host can appear here.
- No workflow alias, rule, hook or enforcement claim is shipped.
